title: AG-UI — Agent-User Interaction Protocol
abstract: AG-UI (Agent-User Interaction Protocol) by CopilotKit defines how AI agents stream rich output to frontend applications — streaming chat, generative UI, shared state, human-in-the-loop interactions, and tool rendering. It complements MCP (agent↔tools) and A2A (agent↔agent) as the agent↔user layer.
why_we_care: MCP solves how agents access tools and data. A2A solves how agents talk to each other. AG-UI solves the remaining gap: how agents display results and interact with users in real-time. For IntelHub, AG-UI would transform the desktop app from a data viewer into an AI-native workspace with streaming chat, generative intell cards, and conversational creation flows.
